alkaptonuria.def: a rare recessive metabolic anomaly marked by ochronosis and the presence of alkapton in the urine

allopatry.def: the occurrence of related organisms in separate geographical areas with no overlap

angiopathy.def: any disease of the blood vessels or lymph ducts

prestige.def: a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.

mesalliance.def: a marriage with a person of inferior social status

elephantiasis.def: hypertrophy of certain body parts (usually legs and scrotum); the end state of the disease filariasis

hypotonus.def: (of muscular tissue) the state of being hypotonic

servitude.def: state of subjection to an owner or master or forced labor imposed as punishment

oligopoly.def: (economics) a market in which control over the supply of a commodity is in the hands of a small number of producers and each one can influence prices and affect competitors

gameness.def: disability of walking due to crippling of the legs or feet

haematocytopenia.def: an abnormally low number of red blood cells in the blood

ascites.def: accumulation of serous fluid in peritoneal cavity

acroanesthesia.def: loss of sensation in the extremities

bilharzia.def: an infestation with or a resulting infection caused by a parasite of the genus Schistosoma; common in the tropics and Far East; symptoms depend on the part of the body infected

hypogonadism.def: incompetence of the gonads (especially in the male with low testosterone); results in deficient development of secondary sex characteristics and (in prepubertal males) a body with long legs and a short trunk

glioblastoma.def: a fast-growing malignant brain tumor composed of spongioblasts; nearly always fatal

otosclerosis.def: hereditary disorder in which ossification of the labyrinth of the inner ear causes tinnitus and eventual deafness

dependence.def: the state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else

viremia.def: the presence of a virus in the blood stream

aneurysm.def: a cardiovascular disease characterized by a saclike widening of an artery resulting from weakening of the artery wall

hermaphrodism.def: congenital condition in which external genitalia and internal sex organs have both male and female characteristics

entelechy.def: (Aristotle) the state of something that is fully realized; actuality as opposed to potentiality

potence.def: the state of being potent; a male's capacity to have sexual intercourse

entireness.def: the state of being total and complete

neuroblastoma.def: malignant tumor containing embryonic nerve cells; usually metastasizes quickly

talipes.def: congenital deformity of the foot usually marked by a curled shape or twisted position of the ankle and heel and toes

xeroderma.def: a mild form of ichthyosis characterized by abnormal dryness and roughness of the skin

shadowiness.def: relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body

photoretinitis.def: damage to the retina resulting from exposure of the eye to the sun without adequate protection

photalgia.def: pain in the eye resulting from exposure to bright light (often associated with albinism)

disrepute.def: the state of being held in low esteem

psychoneurosis.def: a mental or personality disturbance not attributable to any known neurological or organic dysfunction

dermatomycosis.def: fungal infection of the skin (especially of moist parts covered by clothing)

keratomalacia.def: softening and drying and ulceration of the cornea resulting from vitamin A deficiency; symptom of cystic fibrosis or sprue

pandemonium.def: a state of extreme confusion and disorder

acromphalus.def: abnormal protrusion of the navel; sometimes the start of umbilical hernia

dumps.def: an informal expression for a mildly depressed state

tyranny.def: a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)

phobia.def: an anxiety disorder characterized by extreme and irrational fear of simple things or social situations

sleeplessness.def: a temporary state in which you are unable (or unwilling) to sleep

hypocalcemia.def: abnormally low level of calcium in the blood; associated with hypoparathyroidism or kidney malfunction or vitamin D deficiency

schizothymia.def: resembling schizophrenia but remaining within the bounds of normality

enl.def: an inflammatory complication of leprosy that results in painful skin lesions on the arms and legs and face

earache.def: an ache localized in the middle or inner ear

wetness.def: the condition of containing or being covered by a liquid (especially water)

xerotes.def: the condition of not containing or being covered by a liquid (especially water)

pernio.def: inflammation of the hands and feet caused by exposure to cold and moisture

haemoglobinopathy.def: a blood disease characterized by the presence of abnormal hemoglobins in the blood

nationality.def: people having common origins or traditions and often comprising a nation

wealthiness.def: the state of being rich and affluent; having a plentiful supply of material goods and money

glaucoma.def: an eye disease that damages the optic nerve and impairs vision (sometimes progressing to blindness)

ictus.def: a sudden occurrence (or recurrence) of a disease

enterolithiasis.def: the presence of calculi in the intestines

glanders.def: a destructive and contagious bacterial disease of horses that can be transmitted to humans

migraine.def: a severe recurring vascular headache; occurs more frequently in women than men

hyperpiesia.def: persistent and pathological high blood pressure for which no specific cause can be found

ascendency.def: the state that exists when one person or group has power over another

hypotonicity.def: (of a solution) the extent to which a solution has a lower osmotic pressure than some other

nephralgia.def: pain in the kidney (usually felt in the loins)

tenosynovitis.def: inflammation of a tendon and its enveloping sheath

enterotoxemia.def: a disease of cattle and sheep that is attributed to toxins absorbed from the intestines

polypus.def: a small vascular growth on the surface of a mucous membrane

dts.def: acute delirium caused by alcohol poisoning

strabismus.def: abnormal alignment of one or both eyes

sarcoidosis.def: a chronic disease of unknown cause marked by the formation of nodules in the lungs and liver and lymph glands and salivary glands

pregnancy.def: the state of being pregnant; the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus

pneumothorax.def: abnormal presence of air in the pleural cavity resulting in the collapse of the lung; may be spontaneous (due to injury to the chest) or induced (as a treatment for tuberculosis)

struma.def: abnormally enlarged thyroid gland; can result from underproduction or overproduction of hormone or from a deficiency of iodine in the diet

malnutrition.def: a state of poor nutrition; can result from insufficient or excessive or unbalanced diet or from inability to absorb foods

intravasation.def: entry of foreign matter into a blood vessel

acarophobia.def: a morbid fear of small insects and mites and worms

encephalocele.def: protrusion of brain tissue through a congenital fissure in the skull

clawfoot.def: a deformity of the foot characterized by an abnormally high arch and hyperextension of the toes which gives the foot the appearance of a claw

disassociation.def: the state of being unconnected in memory or imagination

cheiloschisis.def: a congenital cleft in the middle of the upper lip

angiohemophilia.def: a form of hemophilia discovered by Erik von Willebrand; a genetic disorder that is inherited as an autosomal recessive trait; characterized by a deficiency of the coagulation factor and by mucosal bleeding

ascendance.def: the state that exists when one person or group has power over another

unsanitariness.def: a state that is not conducive to health

frambesia.def: an infectious tropical disease resembling syphilis in its early stages; marked by red skin eruptions and ulcerating lesions

hebephrenia.def: a form of schizophrenia characterized by severe disintegration of personality including erratic speech and childish mannerisms and bizarre behavior; usually becomes evident during puberty; the most common diagnostic category in mental institutions

infestation.def: the state of being invaded or overrun by parasites

phycomycosis.def: any fungal infection caused by fungi of the Phycomycetes group

disequilibrium.def: loss of equilibrium attributable to an unstable situation in which some forces outweigh others

metamorphopsia.def: a defect of vision in which objects appear to be distorted; usually due to a defect in the retina

histiocytosis.def: a blood disease characterized by an abnormal multiplication of macrophages

valvulitis.def: inflammation of a valve (especially of a cardiac valve as a consequence of rheumatic fever)

ascendancy.def: the state that exists when one person or group has power over another

gastralgia.def: an ache localized in the stomach or abdominal region

aberrancy.def: a state or condition markedly different from the norm

hypermetropia.def: abnormal condition in which vision for distant objects is better than for near objects

aids.def: a serious (often fatal) disease of the immune system transmitted through blood products especially by sexual contact or contaminated needles

hypocapnia.def: a state in which the level of carbon dioxide in the blood is lower than normal; can result from deep or rapid breathing

ards.def: acute lung injury characterized by coughing and rales; inflammation of the lungs which become stiff and fibrous and cannot exchange oxygen; occurs among persons exposed to irritants such as corrosive chemical vapors or ammonia or chlorine etc.

sodoku.def: the form of ratbite fever occurring in the Far East

fug.def: (British informal) an airless smoky smelly atmosphere

acromikria.def: abnormally small extremities (underdeveloped fingers and toes)

retinopathy.def: a disease of the retina that can result in loss of vision

lambdacism.def: speech defect involving excessive use or unusual pronunciation of the phoneme `l'

aneurism.def: a cardiovascular disease characterized by a saclike widening of an artery resulting from weakening of the artery wall

granuloma.def: a tumor composed of granulation tissue resulting from injury or inflammation or infection

grippe.def: an acute febrile highly contagious viral disease

quinsy.def: a painful pus filled inflammation of the tonsils and surrounding tissues; usually a complication of tonsillitis

paraparesis.def: a slight paralysis or weakness of both legs

nearsightedness.def: (ophthalmology) eyesight abnormality resulting from the eye's faulty refractive ability; distant objects appear blurred

oesophagitis.def: inflammation of the esophagus; often caused by gastroesophageal reflux

obstipation.def: severe constipation resulting from an obstruction in the intestines

hypermetropy.def: abnormal condition in which vision for distant objects is better than for near objects

heartburn.def: a painful burning sensation in the chest caused by gastroesophageal reflux (backflow from the stomach irritating the esophagus); symptomatic of an ulcer or a diaphragmatic hernia or other disorder

enteroptosis.def: an abnormally downward position of the intestines in the abdominal cavity

analbuminemia.def: an abnormally low level of albumin in the blood serum

hemosiderosis.def: abnormal deposit of hemosiderin; often a symptom of thalassemia or hemochromatosis

sootiness.def: the state of being dirty with soot

bastardy.def: the status of being born to parents who were not married

unreason.def: the state of being irrational; lacking powers of understanding

cicatrix.def: a mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue

sclerosis.def: any pathological hardening or thickening of tissue

atopognosia.def: absence or loss of topognosia; inability to locate correctly a point of touch

hyperlipaemia.def: presence of excess lipids in the blood

lithiasis.def: the formation of stones (calculi) in an internal organ

splenomegaly.def: an abnormal enlargement of the spleen

osteosarcoma.def: malignant bone tumor; most common in children and young adults where it tends to affect the femur

asbestosis.def: lung disease caused by inhaling asbestos particles

ichthyosis.def: any of several congenital diseases in which the skin is dry and scaly like a fish

strangles.def: an acute bacterial disease of horses characterized by inflammation of the mucous membranes

laryngotracheobronchitis.def: inflammation of the larynx and trachea and bronchial passageways

hypolipoproteinemia.def: any of various disorders of lipoprotein and cholesterol metabolism that result in low levels of lipoprotein and cholesterol in the circulating blood

uricaciduria.def: presence of abnormal amounts of uric acid in the urine; symptom of gout

purpura.def: any of several blood diseases causing subcutaneous bleeding

isometropia.def: equality of refractive power in the two eyes

palmature.def: an abnormality in which the fingers are webbed

tonus.def: the elastic tension of living muscles, arteries, etc. that facilitate response to stimuli

mumps.def: an acute contagious viral disease characterized by fever and by swelling of the parotid glands

circumstances.def: your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)

osteoblastoma.def: benign tumor of bone and fibrous tissue; occurs in the vertebrae or femur or tibia or arm bones (especially in young adults)

kingship.def: the dignity or rank or position of a king

acorea.def: absence of the pupil in an eye

villeinage.def: the legal status or condition of servitude of a villein or feudal serf

antisepsis.def: (of non-living objects) the state of being free of pathogenic organisms

demineralization.def: abnormal loss of mineral salts (especially from bone)

xanthomatosis.def: widespread xanthomas (especially on elbows and knees); often associated with a disorder of lipid metabolism

hematocoele.def: swelling caused by blood collecting in a body cavity (especially a swelling of the membrane covering the testis)

omnipresence.def: the state of being everywhere at once (or seeming to be everywhere at once)

adenopathy.def: a glandular disease or enlargement of glandular tissue (especially of the lymph glands)

blackwater.def: any of several human or animal diseases characterized by dark urine resulting from rapid breakdown of red blood cells

acidosis.def: abnormally high acidity (excess hydrogen-ion concentration) of the blood and other body tissues

cowpox.def: a viral disease of cattle causing a mild skin disease affecting the udder; formerly used to inoculate humans against smallpox

sprain.def: a painful injury to a joint caused by a sudden wrenching of its ligaments

valgus.def: a deformity in which there is an abnormal displacement of part of a limb away from the midline of the body

nudeness.def: the state of being without clothing or covering of any kind

lgv.def: infectious disease caused by a species of chlamydia bacterium; transmitted by sexual contact; characterized by genital lesions and swelling of lymph nodes in the groin

myoclonus.def: a clonic spasm of a muscle or muscle group

poignance.def: a state of deeply felt distress or sorrow

chorditis.def: inflammation of the spermatic cord or vocal cords or vocal folds

disease.def: an impairment of health or a condition of abnormal functioning

myxoma.def: a benign tumor of connective tissue containing jellylike material

sterileness.def: (of non-living objects) the state of being free of pathogenic organisms

cacogenesis.def: inability to produce hybrids that are both viable and fertile

knock-knee.def: an inward slant of the thigh

arthropathy.def: a pathology or abnormality of a joint

flawlessness.def: the state of being without a flaw or defect

haleness.def: a state of robust good health

psammoma.def: a tumor derived from fibrous tissue of the meninges or choroid plexus or certain other structures associated with the brain; characterized by sandlike particles

balanitis.def: inflammation of the head of the penis

anosmia.def: absence of the sense of smell (as by damage to olfactory nasal tissue or the olfactory nerve or by obstruction of the nasal passages)

megacephaly.def: an abnormally large head; differs from hydrocephalus because there is no increased intracranial pressure and the overgrowth is symmetrical

amour.def: a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship

steatorrhea.def: the presence of greater than normal amounts of fat in the feces which are frothy and foul smelling and floating; a symptom of disorders of fat metabolism and malabsorption syndrome

snowblindness.def: temporary blindness caused by exposure to sunlight reflected from snow or ice

diestrum.def: (of animals having several estrous cycles in one breeding season) a state or interval of sexual inactivity or quiescence between periods of activity

seminoma.def: malignant tumor of the testis; usually occurring in older men

coziness.def: a state of warm snug comfort

sequela.def: any abnormality following or resulting from a disease or injury or treatment

charley-horse.def: a muscular cramp (especially in the thigh or calf) following vigorous exercise

insomnia.def: an inability to sleep; chronic sleeplessness

neurilemoma.def: tumor of the fibrous covering of a peripheral nerve

vesiculitis.def: inflammation of a seminal vesicle (usually in conjunction with prostatitis)

red-blindness.def: dichromacy characterized by lowered sensitivity to long wavelengths of light resulting in an inability to distinguish red and purplish blue

tetanilla.def: clinical neurological syndrome characterized by muscular twitching and cramps and (when severe) seizures; associated with calcium deficiency (hypoparathyroidism) or vitamin D deficiency or alkalosis

hyponatremia.def: abnormally low level of sodium in the blood; associated with dehydration

immanence.def: the state of being within or not going beyond a given domain

protanopia.def: dichromacy characterized by lowered sensitivity to long wavelengths of light resulting in an inability to distinguish red and purplish blue

mange.def: a persistent and contagious disease of the skin causing inflammation and itching and loss of hair; affects domestic animals (and sometimes people)

toxoplasmosis.def: infection caused by parasites transmitted to humans from infected cats; if contracted by a pregnant woman it can result in serious damage to the fetus

ptosis.def: drooping of the upper eyelid caused by muscle paralysis and weakness

requisiteness.def: the state of being absolutely required

decadency.def: the state of being degenerate in mental or moral qualities

glioma.def: a tumor of the brain consisting of neuroglia

hemangioma.def: benign angioma consisting of a mass of blood vessels; some appear as birthmarks

prurigo.def: chronic inflammatory disease of the skin characterized by blister capped papules and intense itching

pleuralgia.def: pain in the chest caused by inflammation of the muscles between the ribs

eudaimonia.def: a contented state of being happy and healthy and prosperous

dieback.def: a disease of plants characterized by the gradual dying of the young shoots starting at the tips and progressing to the larger branches

aphonia.def: a disorder of the vocal organs that results in the loss of voice

schistosomiasis.def: an infestation with or a resulting infection caused by a parasite of the genus Schistosoma; common in the tropics and Far East; symptoms depend on the part of the body infected

myxomatosis.def: a viral disease (usually fatal) of rabbits

nec.def: an acute inflammatory disease occurring in the intestines of premature infants; necrosis of intestinal tissue may follow

degeneration.def: the process of declining from a higher to a lower level of effective power or vitality or essential quality

acne.def: an inflammatory disease involving the sebaceous glands of the skin; characterized by papules or pustules or comedones

bronchitis.def: inflammation of the membranes lining the bronchial tubes

inherency.def: the state of inhering; the state of being a fixed characteristic

hematocytopenia.def: an abnormally low number of red blood cells in the blood

bacteremia.def: transient presence of bacteria (or other microorganisms) in the blood

anoxemia.def: abnormally low oxygen content in arterial blood

heterotaxy.def: any abnormal position of the organs of the body

uropathy.def: any pathology of the urinary tract

aridness.def: a deficiency of moisture (especially when resulting from a permanent absence of rainfall)

stammer.def: a speech disorder involving hesitations and involuntary repetitions of certain sounds

hypospadias.def: an abnormal condition in males in which the urethra opens on the under surface of the penis

arteriectasis.def: an abnormal distension of an artery

dyschezia.def: difficulty in defecating (usually as a consequence of long continued voluntary suppression of the urge to defecate)

tympanites.def: distension of the abdomen that is caused by the accumulation of gas in the intestines or the peritoneal cavity

hyperlipidaemia.def: presence of excess lipids in the blood

encephalopathy.def: any disorder or disease of the brain

plasmacytoma.def: neoplasm of plasma cells (usually in bone marrow)

ch'i.def: the circulating life energy that in Chinese philosophy is thought to be inherent in all things; in traditional Chinese medicine the balance of negative and positive forms in the body is believed to be essential for good health

kwashiorkor.def: severe malnutrition in children resulting from a diet excessively high in carbohydrates and low in protein

vellication.def: a sudden muscle spasm; especially one caused by a nervous condition

vaginitis.def: inflammation of the vagina (usually associated with candidiasis)

hematocyturia.def: the presence of red blood cells in the urine

radiculitis.def: inflammation of the radicle of a nerve

rateability.def: the state of being liable to assessment or taxation

agnosia.def: inability to recognize objects by use of the senses

successfulness.def: the condition of prospering; having good fortune

phlebothrombosis.def: thrombosis of a vein without prior inflammation of the vein; associated with sluggish blood flow (as in prolonged bedrest or pregnancy or surgery) or with rapid coagulation of the blood

mayidism.def: a disease caused by deficiency of niacin or tryptophan (or by a defect in the metabolic conversion of tryptophan to niacin); characterized by gastrointestinal disturbances and erythema and nervous or mental disorders; may be caused by malnutrition or alcoholism or other nutritional impairments

prostatitis.def: inflammation of the prostate gland characterized by perineal pain and irregular urination and (if severe) chills and fever

pollinosis.def: a seasonal rhinitis resulting from an allergic reaction to pollen

detainment.def: a state of being confined (usually for a short time)

chilblains.def: inflammation of the hands and feet caused by exposure to cold and moisture

automysophobia.def: a morbid fear of being dirty

parenthood.def: the state of being a parent

blastocytoma.def: a tumor composed of immature undifferentiated cells

hyperbilirubinemia.def: abnormally high amounts of bile pigment (bilirubin) in the blood

primacy.def: the state of being first in importance

severalty.def: the state of being several and distinct

otalgia.def: an ache localized in the middle or inner ear

measles.def: an acute and highly contagious viral disease marked by distinct red spots followed by a rash; occurs primarily in children

silicosis.def: a lung disease caused by inhaling particles of silica or quartz or slate

eclampsia.def: a toxic condition characterized by convulsions and possibly coma during or immediately after pregnancy

incompleteness.def: the state of being crude and incomplete and imperfect

dermatosis.def: disorder involving lesions or eruptions of the skin (in which there is usually no inflammation)

eosinopenia.def: a decrease in the number of eosinophils in the blood

hyperadrenalism.def: a glandular disorder caused by excessive ACTH resulting in greater than normal functioning of the adrenal gland; characterized by obesity

petechia.def: a minute red or purple spot on the surface of the skin as the result of tiny hemorrhages of blood vessels in the skin (as in typhoid fever)

coccidiomycosis.def: an infection of the lungs and skin characterized by excessive sputum and nodules

gumma.def: a small rubbery granuloma that is characteristic of an advanced stage of syphilis

enanthema.def: eruption on a mucous membrane (as the inside of the mouth) occurring as a symptom of a disease

goiter.def: abnormally enlarged thyroid gland; can result from underproduction or overproduction of hormone or from a deficiency of iodine in the diet

opisthotonos.def: severe spasm in which the back arches and the head bends back and heels flex toward the back

stagnancy.def: inactivity of liquids; being stagnant; standing still; without current or circulation

longsightedness.def: abnormal condition in which vision for distant objects is better than for near objects

polyvalence.def: (chemistry) the state of having a valence greater than two

paraphrenia.def: a form of schizophrenia characterized by delusions (of persecution or grandeur or jealousy); symptoms may include anger and anxiety and aloofness and doubts about gender identity; unlike other types of schizophrenia the patients are usually presentable and (if delusions are not acted on) may function in an apparently normal manner

deshabille.def: the state of being carelessly or partially dressed

hyperlipoidaemia.def: presence of excess lipids in the blood

beriberi.def: avitaminosis caused by lack of thiamine (vitamin B1)

cretinism.def: severe hypothyroidism resulting in physical and mental stunting

histoincompatibility.def: incompatibility in which one person's tissue cannot be transplanted to another person

tularemia.def: a highly infectious disease of rodents (especially rabbits and squirrels) and sometimes transmitted to humans by ticks or flies or by handling infected animals

green-blindness.def: dichromacy characterized by a lowered sensitivity to green light resulting in an inability to distinguish green and purplish-red

keratoscleritis.def: inflammation of the cornea and sclera of the eye

diverticulum.def: a herniation through the muscular wall of a tubular organ (especially the colon)

enchondroma.def: benign slow-growing tumor of cartilaginous cells at the ends of tubular bones (especially in the hands and feet)

despotism.def: dominance through threat of punishment and violence

ptsd.def: an anxiety disorder associated with serious traumatic events and characterized by such symptoms as survivor guilt, reliving the trauma in dreams, numbness and lack of involvement with reality, or recurrent thoughts and images

hemorrhoid.def: venous swelling external or internal to the anal sphincter

emphysema.def: an abnormal condition of the lungs marked by decreased respiratory function; associated with smoking or chronic bronchitis or old age

hypercalcinuria.def: the presence of abnormally high levels of calcium in the urine; usually the result of excessive bone resorption in hyperparathyroidism or osteoporosis

companionship.def: the state of being with someone

iridocyclitis.def: inflammation of the iris and ciliary body of the eye

twitching.def: a sudden muscle spasm; especially one caused by a nervous condition

friendship.def: the state of being friends (or friendly)

garboil.def: a state of commotion and noise and confusion

impregnability.def: having the strength to withstand attack

deterioration.def: a symptom of reduced quality or strength

acephaly.def: absence of the head (as in the development of some monsters)

tay-sachs.def: a hereditary disorder of lipid metabolism occurring most frequently in individuals of Jewish descent in eastern Europe; accumulation of lipids in nervous tissue results in death in early childhood

impendency.def: the state of being imminent and liable to happen soon

gynecomastia.def: excessive development of the breasts in males; usually the result of hormonal imbalance or treatment with certain drugs (including some antihypertensives)

thromboembolism.def: occlusion of a blood vessel by an embolus that has broken away from a thrombus

furuncle.def: a painful sore with a hard core filled with pus

esotropia.def: strabismus in which one or both eyes turn inward toward the nose

rhinorrhea.def: persistent watery mucus discharge from the nose (as in the common cold)

thrombosis.def: the formation or presence of a thrombus (a clot of coagulated blood attached at the site of its formation) in a blood vessel

cicatrice.def: a mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue

fibrosis.def: development of excess fibrous connective tissue in an organ

acathexia.def: an inability to retain bodily secretions

dysaphia.def: a disorder in the sense of touch

vacuolization.def: the state of having become filled with vacuoles

varix.def: abnormally enlarged or twisted blood vessel or lymphatic vessel

hamartia.def: the character flaw or error of a tragic hero that leads to his downfall

exomphalos.def: an umbilical hernia at birth in which some abdominal organs push into the umbilical cord

hypocalcaemia.def: abnormally low level of calcium in the blood; associated with hypoparathyroidism or kidney malfunction or vitamin D deficiency

post-menopause.def: the state in which women have stopped ovulating

urticaria.def: an itchy skin eruption characterized by weals with pale interiors and well-defined red margins; usually the result of an allergic response to insect bites or food or drugs

fructosuria.def: the presence of levulose is the urine

nonoccurrence.def: absence by virtue of not occurring

aphasia.def: inability to use or understand language (spoken or written) because of a brain lesion

salmonellosis.def: a kind of food poisoning caused by eating foods contaminated with Salmonella typhimurium

isostasy.def: (geology) a general equilibrium of the forces tending to elevate or depress the earth's crust

dermatosclerosis.def: an autoimmune disease that affects the blood vessels and connective tissue; fibrous connective tissue is deposited in the skin

distomatosis.def: a disease of the liver (especially in sheep and cattle) caused by liver flukes and their by-products

periarteritis.def: inflammation of the outer coat of an artery

anthrax.def: a highly infectious animal disease (especially cattle and sheep); it can be transmitted to people

discreteness.def: the state of being several and distinct

traumatophobia.def: a morbid fear of battle or physical injury

suntan.def: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun

dichromacy.def: a deficiency of color vision in which the person can match any given hue by mixing only two other wavelengths of light (as opposed to the three wavelengths needed by people with normal color vision)

aerodontalgia.def: pain in the teeth that results from a change in air pressure (as in flying or mountain climbing)

intumescence.def: swelling up with blood or other fluids (as with congestion)

elastosis.def: breakdown of elastic tissue (as the loss of elasticity in the skin of elderly people that results from degeneration of connective tissue)

amastia.def: absence of the mammary glands (either through surgery or developmental defect)

colpoxerosis.def: a condition in which the vagina is unusually dry

philistinism.def: a desire for wealth and material possessions with little interest in ethical or spiritual matters
